program:
PARAMS = {
    "L1":    (0.4, 0.25, 0.8),         # CS device L (gm/Id follows from fixed 0.75 V gate)
    "I1":    (88e-6, 70e-6, 92e-6),    # main branch current
    "gmidp": (8.0, 6.0, 11.0),         # PMOS load gm/Id
    "Lp":    (0.6, 0.3, 1.5),          # PMOS load L
    "k":     (10.0, 8.0, 12.0),        # main / replica ratio (rounded to integer fingers)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vg = spec.get("vin_dc", spec.get("vcm", 0.75))
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    k = int(round(p["k"]))
    I1 = p["I1"]
    Ir = I1 / k
    I1 = Ir * k

    # Replica node sets output DC: vo = vdd - vsg(PMOS)
    vo = 0.7
    for _ in range(4):
        mpu = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ir, vds=max(vdd - vo, 0.2))
        vo = vdd - mpu.vgs

    # NMOS gate fixed at vg, so gm/Id follows from L
    o = lut.op("n", 1.0, p["L1"], vg, vo)
    gmid1 = o["gm_id"]
    m1u = lut.size("n", gmid1, p["L1"], Ir, vds=vo)

    # Main devices: k fingers identical to the replica unit (exact ratio)
    m1 = lut.size("n", gmid1, p["L1"], I1, vds=vo)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=max(vdd - vo, 0.2))

    # Sink for the reference current
    mr = lut.size("n", 12.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)
    mr = lut.size("n", 12.0, 1.0, iref, vds=mr.vgs)

    # Divider gives the replica gate vg
    Rtot = 7.2e6
    Rbot = Rtot * vg / vdd
    Rtop = Rtot - Rbot

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", m1, m=k)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "pd", "vdd", "vdd", mp, m=k)
    n.dev("M1R", "pd", "vref", "vss", "vss", m1u, m=1)
    n.dev("M2R", "pd", "pd", "vdd", "vdd", mpu, m=1)
    n.dev("MNR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.R("RT", "vdd", "vref", Rtop)
    n.R("RB", "vref", "vss", Rbot)

    # First-order predictions
    gds_t = m1.gds + mp.gds
    A = m1.gm / gds_t
    Ctot = cl + m1.cdd + m1.cgd + mp.cdd + mp.cgd
    f3db = gds_t / (2 * PI * Ctot)
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Ctot)
    power = vdd * (I1 + Ir + iref + vdd / Rtot)
    swing = (vdd - mp.vdsat - 0.05) - (m1.vdsat + 0.05)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "f3db": f3db, "gbw": gbw,
               "power": power, "vout_dc": vo, "swing": swing}
